title: Morse lower bound for nondegenerate Hamiltonian fixed points
exact_target: For every closed connected symplectic manifold M and every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism $\varphi $ with nondegenerate fixed points, must $\#Fix(\varphi )$ be at least the minimum number of critical points of a Morse function on M? The minimum is restricted to Morse functions, whereas the existing Crit record is not.
